task.request: Use the Simple writing guidance to shorten and organise this update into a handoff for the incident lead. Use no more than 100 words. Keep the handoff useful for deciding what happens next. Return only the revised handoff.
task.source: The local change is ready, so this is an update on where things have got to and what needs to happen next. The queue consumer now records a delivery receipt before removing the message. I ran all 12 checks in the disposable fixture and they passed. The change has not been deployed. Tessa needs to inspect the receipt from staging and tell Omar whether it matches the submitted batch. Omar may rerun the failed staging batch only after Tessa confirms that match. If the receipt is missing, Omar must leave the batch alone and report that to Tessa. After an authorised rerun, Omar sends its outcome to Tessa. We do not yet know how long the rerun will take. The next action is Tessa’s receipt check.
